description: Provision a Google Cloud Edgecontainer EdgeContainerVpnConnection via Config Connector. Fields mirror the edgecontainer.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 EdgeContainerVpnConnection spec.

clusterRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of an `EdgeContainerCluster` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

enableHighAvailability.description: Immutable. Whether this VPN connection has HA enabled on cluster side. If enabled, when creating VPN connection we will attempt to use 2 ANG floating IPs.

natGatewayIp.description:
Immutable. NAT gateway IP, or WAN IP address. If a customer has multiple NAT IPs, the customer needs to configure NAT such that only one external IP maps to the GMEC Anthos cluster.
This is empty if NAT is not used.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

router.description: The VPN connection Cloud Router name.

vpc.description: Immutable. The network ID of VPC to connect to.

vpcProject.description: Project detail of the VPC network. Required if VPC is in a different project than the cluster project.

projectId.description: Immutable. The project of the VPC to connect to. If not specified, it is the same as the cluster project.

title: GCP Edgecontainer EdgeContainerVpnConnection
